title: Room CRUD within a floor
description: Add/edit/delete rooms under a floor: room number, type (single/double/triple), price per bed, amenities.
acceptanceCriteria: Room type, price, and amenities are captured and editable
Deleting a room is blocked or warned if it has active tenants

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting. The 'blocked if active tenants' AC needs Bed data even though bed-generation UI is LODGY-9's job - the Bed entity/DAO already exist from LODGY-2, so adding a minimal BedRepository now (just a hasOccupiedBed check) to satisfy this ticket's AC; LODGY-9 will extend it with actual bed creation/generation. Going with 'blocked' (not just warned) for the active-tenant case - letting a warden delete a room out from under a live tenant seemed like the riskier reading of an explicit either/or in the AC.

Built data/repository/RoomRepository.kt + BedRepository.kt (hasOccupiedBed check), ui/property/RoomListViewModel.kt + RoomListScreen.kt (room cards with type chip, edit/delete icons, delete routes through requestDelete which checks hasOccupiedBed first and shows a blocking AlertDialog instead of deleting if any bed on the room is OCCUPIED), ui/property/RoomFormViewModel.kt + RoomFormScreen.kt (room number, SINGLE/DOUBLE/TRIPLE filter chips, price-per-bed as a numeric field kept as String state and parsed on save, amenities free text). Wired room_list/{floorId} and room_form/{floorId}?roomId={id} into LodgyNavHost; FloorListScreen's onOpenRooms now actually navigates instead of being a no-op. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. AC1 (type/price/amenities captured+editable) and AC2 (blocked with occupied bed) both implemented in code; AC2 specifically can't be exercised end-to-end on-device until LODGY-9 lets a bed actually be marked OCCUPIED (right now hasOccupiedBed always returns false since no beds exist yet) - the check itself is real and will engage correctly once beds do, but flagging that Tester can't fully verify AC2's blocking behavior until LODGY-9/13 land. On-device pass still queued behind the slow emulator boot.
